title: Discord notification sink
summary: Send DontPanic NotifyEvent messages to a Discord webhook for read-only operator awareness.

verify.readiness: Webhook URL configured by env var or ~/.dontpanic/discord.json. Network delivery can be smoke-tested with an explicit operator action.

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: DontPanic emits NotifyEvent; sink POSTs to Discord webhook. Discord messages do not mutate DontPanic state.
forbidden: Treating Discord messages as approval commands
Writing gate or plan state from Discord webhook delivery

notes: This is a direct sink for simple receive-only use. Bidirectional chat belongs in a broker such as OpenClaw, not this sink.
